home_subtitle: 第四课 · 我的交流日记
part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：跟站长学用现在完成时写交流日记，中间穿插挑战题和写句练习。
part2_desc: 第 28–55 步：独立写日记闯关（挑战题穿插其中），完形填空 4 空，再闯课尾压轴挑战，最后写一整段交流日记。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：用现在完成时写作、never/already、and/but/because；难度均匀分布全程：主课段穿插挑战题与产出型写句题（否定/疑问变换、since/for、三单 Has、被动辨析、最高级+完成时混搭），新增完形填空 4 空（中考题型），课末有一段 3 信息点日记写作。Unit 5 Educational exchanges 主题。

steps.title: 交流墙日记
steps.teach_html:
交流特别节目快做完了。站长说：咱们在广播站门口办一面交流墙，请同学们写交流日记 (diary)，讲讲自己的经历。

这期不讲新语法，咱们学用现在完成时写经历。写得好的日记，站长要在节目里读出来！

steps.title: 日记三部分
steps.teach_html:
一篇交流日记有三部分：

1. 开头：说时间地点。This week I joined the exchange program.（这周我参加了交流活动。）

2. 经历：用现在完成时写做过的事。I have visited the museum.（我参观过博物馆。）

3. 感受：说想法。It was great.（很好。）

steps.title: 用完成时写经历
steps.teach_html:
写经历时，每件事用 have/has + 过去分词：

I have met new friends.（我认识了新朋友。）

She has tried Chinese food.（她尝过中国菜。）

记住：一件经历一句话，一个 have/has。

steps.title: 用 never 写“还没”
steps.teach_html:
想写“还没做过的事”，用 have never + 过去分词：

I have never seen snow.（我从没见过雪。）

这样写，读者一下就知道你的“第一次”心愿单。

steps.title: 用 already 写“已经”
steps.teach_html:
想写“已经做过的事”，用 have already + 过去分词：

I have already learned to use chopsticks.（我已经学会用筷子了。）

already 让句子有种“小骄傲”的感觉。

steps.title: 连接词
steps.teach_html:
句子之间用连接词串起来，文章更顺：

and（和）：I have visited the museum and tried dumplings.

but（但是）：I have been to Beijing, but I have never seen snow.

because（因为）：I like it because it is fun.

steps.title: 范文
steps.teach_html:
看一篇范文：

My Exchange Week
I have met three new friends this week. I have already visited the school library. I have never tried Chinese noodles, but I want to try them because they look yummy.

三句话，三个完成时：met、already visited、never tried。清楚又漂亮。

steps.title: 写作检查清单
steps.teach_html:
写完对照检查：

1. 每句经历都用了 have/has + 过去分词吗？

2. he/she 开头用了 has 吗？

3. 过去分词写对了吗？（不规则的要留心）

4. 用了 and/but/because 连句子吗？

steps.title: 小结
steps.teach_html:
小结：日记 = 开头 + 经历（have/has + 过去分词）+ 感受；never 写“还没”，already 写“已经”，and/but/because 连句。

下面站长带着你练写。资料卡在上面，做题时对照着看。

steps.title: 先看范文
steps.teach_html:
这是范文。做题时对照着看：认识了两个朋友—已逛过公园—没吃过火锅但想尝因为闻着香。

下面练写日记的句子。
steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 认识了朋友
steps.scene: 我想写“认识了两个朋友”。
steps.stem: I have ______ two friends.
steps.help: meet 的过去分词是？
steps.explain: I have met two friends.

wrong_feedback.A: meet 是原形，用过去分词 met。
wrong_feedback.B: meets 是三单现在时，不对。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 已经逛过
steps.scene: 我想写“已经逛过公园”。
steps.stem: I have ______ visited the park.
steps.help: 肯定句里“已经”用什么？
steps.explain: I have already visited the park.

wrong_feedback.A: yet 不放肯定句中间，用 already。
wrong_feedback.D: ever 是“曾经”，这里“已经”用 already。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 没吃过
steps.scene: 我想写“没吃过火锅”。
steps.stem: I have ______ eaten hotpot.
steps.help: “从没”用什么？
steps.explain: I have never eaten hotpot.

wrong_feedback.B: ever 是“曾经”，这里“从没”用 never。
wrong_feedback.D: just 是“刚刚”，这里用 never。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 挑战 · 住在这里十年了
steps.scene: 他们住在这个镇上已经十年了。
steps.stem: They have lived in this town ______ ten years.
steps.help: 先看空后面是多长一段时间，还是一个时间点。
steps.explain: They have lived in this town for ten years.

common_errors.say: since 后面跟的是时间点（如 2020 年）；ten years 是一段时间，要用 for。
from 是“从某地/某时来”，不表示持续多久；持续十年用 for。
in + 时间段多指“在……之后”，将来才发生；已经持续了十年要用 for。

steps.title: 她尝过
steps.scene: 写“她尝过中国菜”。
steps.stem: She ______ tried Chinese food.
steps.help: she 用哪个？
steps.explain: She has tried Chinese food.

wrong_feedback.A: have 用于 I/you/we/they。she 用 has。
wrong_feedback.B: is 是 be 动词，不对。
wrong_feedback.C: are 是 be 动词复数，不对。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 想尝因为
steps.scene: 我想尝因为闻着香。
steps.stem: I want to try it ______ it smells nice.
steps.help: 表原因用什么？
steps.explain: I want to try it because it smells nice.

wrong_feedback.B: and 表并列，这里表原因用 because。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 转折
steps.scene: 去过北京，但没见过雪。
steps.stem: I have been to Beijing, ______ I have never seen snow.
steps.help: 前后转折用什么？
steps.explain: I have been to Beijing, but I have never seen snow.

wrong_feedback.A: and 表并列，这里转折用 but。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 写一写：改成否定句
steps.scene: 日记里要写“我还没参观过博物馆”。
steps.stem: 把这个句子改成否定句，写出完整的句子：I have visited the museum.
steps.task: 写出改好的完整句子（用 never 或 haven't 都可以）。
steps.answer_text: I have never visited the museum.
steps.help: 否定有两种写法，想一想 never 应该站在哪个词后面。
steps.explain: I have never visited the museum.（也可以写 I haven't visited the museum.）

common_errors.say: 主语是 I，用 have：I have never visited…，has 是给第三人称单数用的。

common_errors.when: 把 never 写在 visited 后面
common_errors.say: never 要放在 have 和过去分词中间：have never visited，不能写成 visited never。
didn't 是过去时否定；写“还没做过”要用现在完成时：have never visited。

common_errors.when: 漏了 have 只写 never visited
common_errors.say: 句子的骨架是 have + 过去分词，have 不能省：I have never visited…。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 刚到
steps.scene: 我刚认识新朋友。
steps.stem: I have ______ met new friends.
steps.help: “刚刚”用什么？
steps.explain: I have just met new friends.

wrong_feedback.A: already 是“已经”，这里“刚刚”用 just。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 写出过去分词：try
steps.scene: 把 try 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 try 的过去分词。
steps.help: 规则：y 变 i 加 ed。
steps.explain: try → tried（y 变 i 再加 ed）。

common_errors.say: try 是辅音字母+y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 ed：tried。
tries 是第三人称单数现在时；过去分词要写 tried。
trying 是现在分词；have 后面用过去分词 tried。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: have 还是 has
steps.scene: 我们已经吃过了。
steps.stem: We have ___ eaten.
steps.help: 肯定句“已经”用什么？
steps.explain: We have already eaten.

common_errors.say: yet 用在否定句和疑问句；这句是肯定句，“已经”用 already。
just 是“刚刚”；这句只说“已经”吃过，用 already。
never 是“从不”，意思反了；“已经”用 already。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 挑战 · 很多地方种茶
steps.scene: 中国很多地方都种茶。
steps.stem: Tea ______ in many parts of China.
steps.help: 先想：茶是自己种自己的，还是被人种的？
steps.explain: Tea is grown in many parts of China.

wrong_feedback.A: grows 是主动语态，意思是“（茶）自己生长”；茶是被人种的，要用被动 is grown。
wrong_feedback.B: grew 是主动语态的过去式，同样是主动；茶被种，要用被动语态 is grown。
wrong_feedback.D: is growing 是“正在生长”，还是主动意思；“种茶”是人对茶做的事，用被动 is grown。

steps.title: 写出过去分词：swim
steps.scene: 把 swim 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 swim 的过去分词。
steps.help: 不规则。
steps.explain: swim → swum。

common_errors.say: swim 是不规则动词，不能加 ed；过去分词是 swum。
swam 是过去式；have 后面要用过去分词 swum。
swimming 是现在分词；这里要过去分词 swum。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 连词
steps.scene: 我想吃火锅，因为很香。
steps.stem: I want hotpot ___ it smells nice.
steps.help: 表原因用什么？
steps.explain: I want hotpot because it smells nice.

common_errors.say: and 是并列“和”；后半句是想吃的原因，用 because。
but 表转折；“因为很香”是原因，用 because。
or 表选择“或者”；这里前后是原因和结果，用 because。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 写出过去分词：ride
steps.scene: 把 ride 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 ride 的过去分词。
steps.help: 不规则。
steps.explain: ride → ridden。

common_errors.say: ride 是不规则动词，不能直接加 ed；过去分词是 ridden。
rode 是过去式；have 后面要用过去分词 ridden。
riding 是现在分词；这里要过去分词 ridden。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 写一写：改成疑问句
steps.scene: 你想问同学“他们尝过火锅吗”。
steps.stem: 把这个句子改成一般疑问句，写出完整的问句：They have tried hotpot.
steps.task: 写出完整的问句（问经历，别忘了 ever 的位置）。
steps.help: 疑问句要把哪个词搬到句首？ever 又该跟在谁后面？
steps.explain: Have they ever tried hotpot?（have 提到句首，ever 放在主语 they 后面）

common_errors.say: 主语 they 是复数，句首用 Have，不是 Has。
Did 是问过去某一次；问“尝过没有”这种经历，要用 Have they ever tried…。
ever 在疑问句里放在主语后面、动词前面：Have they ever tried…。
have 后面要用过去分词 tried，不能用原形 try。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: never 还是 ever
steps.scene: 我从没去过。
steps.stem: I have ___ been there.
steps.help: “从没”用什么？
steps.explain: I have never been there.

common_errors.say: ever 是“曾经”，多用在疑问句；这句是“从没”，用 never。
already 是“已经”，和“从没”意思相反；用 never。
yet 放在否定句句尾，不放 have 后面；“从没”用 never。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 新任务：独立写
steps.teach_html:
新任务：这是我的日记范文——加入了俱乐部—已学会唱歌—没上台跳过舞但想试因为看着好玩。

资料在上面。这次你自己看、自己写，站长不提示了。

记住：have/has + 过去分词写经历；never 写“还没”，already 写“已经”；and/but/because 连句。
steps.reading: My diary: I have joined the club. I have already learned to sing. I have never danced on stage, but I want to try because it looks fun.

steps.title: 加入了
steps.scene: 我加入了俱乐部。
steps.stem: I have ______ the club.
steps.help: 过去分词。
steps.explain: I have joined the club.

wrong_feedback.B: join 是动词原形；have 后面要用过去分词 joined。
wrong_feedback.C: joins 是第三人称单数现在时；这里要用过去分词 joined。
wrong_feedback.D: joining 是现在分词；have 后面用过去分词 joined。

steps.reading: My diary: I have joined the club. I have already learned to sing. I have never danced on stage, but I want to try because it looks fun.

steps.title: 挑战 · 十岁起就有了
steps.scene: 这块表从我十岁起就戴着了。
steps.stem: I have had this watch ______ I was ten.
steps.help: 先看空后面跟的是一个起点，还是一段时间。
steps.explain: I have had this watch since I was ten.

common_errors.say: for 后面跟一段时间（如 for ten years）；空后面是“I was ten”这个起点，要用 since。
from 不能这样带出一个起点句子；“自从……”用 since。
when 只是“在……时候”，不表示一直持续到现在；从十岁持续到现在用 since。

steps.title: 已经学会
steps.scene: 我已经学会唱歌。
steps.stem: I have ______ learned to sing.
steps.help: 肯定句“已经”。
steps.explain: I have already learned to sing.

wrong_feedback.A: yet 用在否定句和疑问句的句尾；这句是肯定句，“已经”用 already。
wrong_feedback.B: never 是“从不”，意思反了；“已经学会”用 already。
wrong_feedback.D: ever 是“曾经”，多用在疑问句里；肯定句说“已经”用 already。

steps.reading: My diary: I have joined the club. I have already learned to sing. I have never danced on stage, but I want to try because it looks fun.

steps.title: 写出过去分词：sing
steps.scene: 把 sing 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 sing 的过去分词。
steps.help: 不规则。
steps.explain: sing → sung。

common_errors.say: sing 是不规则动词，不能加 ed；过去分词是 sung。
sang 是过去式；have 后面要用过去分词 sung。
sing 是原形；过去分词是 sung。

steps.reading: My diary: I have joined the club. I have already learned to sing. I have never danced on stage, but I want to try because it looks fun.

steps.title: 挑战 · 还没试过滑雪
steps.scene: 我们还没试过滑雪。
steps.stem: We haven't tried skiing ______.
steps.help: 先看句子是肯定还是否定，再看空在句子的什么位置。
steps.explain: We haven't tried skiing yet.

wrong_feedback.A: already 用在肯定句；这是否定句，“还没”用 yet 放在句尾。
wrong_feedback.B: haven't 已经是否定了，再加 never 就是双重否定，错了；“还没”用 yet。
wrong_feedback.C: ever 是“曾经”，用在疑问句里问经历；这句是“还没试过”，用 yet。

steps.title: 她加入
steps.scene: 她加入了俱乐部。
steps.stem: She ______ joined the club.
steps.help: 三单。
steps.explain: She has joined the club.

wrong_feedback.B: have 用于 I、you、we、they；she 是第三人称单数，用 has。
wrong_feedback.C: is 是 be 动词，后面跟不了 joined 组成完成时；she 用 has。
wrong_feedback.D: are 是复数 be 动词；主语 she 是一人，用 has。

steps.reading: My diary: I have joined the club. I have already learned to sing. I have never danced on stage, but I want to try because it looks fun.

steps.title: 写一写：从2020年起
steps.scene: 日记里写你住在广州的时间。
steps.stem: 用现在完成时写出这个句子：我从 2020 年起就住在广州了。（主语用 I，“住”用 live）
steps.answer_text: I have lived in Guangzhou since 2020.
steps.help: 2020 是时间点还是时间段？先想清楚，再选那个词。
steps.explain: I have lived in Guangzhou since 2020.（since + 时间点 2020）

common_errors.say: for 后面跟一段时间（如 for five years）；2020 是时间点，要用 since。
主语是 I，用 have lived；has 只配第三人称单数。
have 后面要用过去分词 lived，不能用原形 live。

common_errors.when: 漏了 have 只写 lived
common_errors.say: lived 是过去式，句子就变成“过去住过”；表示一直住到现在要用 have lived。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: have 还是 has
steps.scene: 他已经唱过了。
steps.stem: He has ___ sung.
steps.help: 肯定句“已经”。
steps.explain: He has already sung.

common_errors.say: yet 用在否定句和疑问句；这句是肯定句，“已经”用 already。
just 是“刚刚”；这句只说“已经”唱过，用 already。
never 是“从不”，意思反了；“已经”用 already。

steps.reading: My diary: I have joined the club. I have already learned to sing. I have never danced on stage, but I want to try because it looks fun.

steps.title: 挑战 · 老学校
steps.scene: 这所老学校建于 2010 年，学生们从那时起就在这里学习。
steps.stem: The old school ______ in 2010, and students have studied there ______ then.
steps.task: 写出两个空里的词（第一个空两个词，第二个空一个词）。
steps.answer_text: The old school was built in 2010, and students have studied there since then.
steps.help: 先看两个信号：2010 年已经过去了；后半句是从那时一直到现在。
steps.explain: The old school was built in 2010, and students have studied there since then.

common_errors.say: built 是主动过去式；学校是被建成的，被动语态不能少 be 动词：was built。

common_errors.when: 第一个空写了 is built
common_errors.say: 建学校是 2010 年的事，用过去的被动 was built，不能用 is。
for 后面要跟一段时间；then 是那个时间点，“从那时起”用 since。
from 不能单独表示“自从那时起一直到现在”；这里用 since。

steps.title: 写出过去分词：dance
steps.scene: 把 dance 变成过去分词。
steps.stem: 写出 dance 的过去分词。
steps.help: 规则加 ed。
steps.explain: dance → danced（e 结尾直接加 d）。

common_errors.say: dance 以 e 结尾，直接加 d：danced，不要重复加 ed。
dance 是原形；过去分词要在词尾加 d：danced。
dances 是第三人称单数现在时；这里要过去分词 danced。

steps.reading: My diary: I have joined the club. I have already learned to sing. I have never danced on stage, but I want to try because it looks fun.

steps.title: 挑战 · 最有趣的书
steps.scene: 这是我读过的最有趣的书。
steps.stem: This is the ______ book I have ever read.
steps.help: 先看范围：是跟一本书比，还是在读过的所有书里最……。
steps.explain: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.

wrong_feedback.A: more interesting 是比较级，用来跟一本书比；the 后面加上“I have ever read”是最大范围，要用最高级 most interesting。
wrong_feedback.C: interesting 是多音节词，最高级要在前面加 most，不能在词尾加 er。
wrong_feedback.D: 句子里已经有 the 了，空里再写 the 就重复了；空里只写 most interesting。

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形短文
steps.teach_html:
新题型：完形填空。先把短文读一遍，知道大概讲什么，再逐个空选。

Lin Tao has just come back from Shanghai. He went on a five-day exchange trip there last week. He has kept a diary __1__ the trip began, and he has written about many new things in it. On the first day, his host brother asked him, “Have you __2__ eaten xiaolongbao?” Lin Tao tried some and loved them. He took many photos and bought a small gift for his mum. The school he visited is famous in the city. It __3__ more than a hundred years ago, and many students study there now. “Shanghai is __4__ than I thought,” Lin Tao says. “I have learned a lot on this trip.”

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第1空
steps.scene: 结合短文上下文选词。
steps.stem: He has kept a diary ______ the trip began, and he has written about many new things in it.
steps.help: 看空后面跟的是什么：是一个时间点（事情开始的那一刻），还是多长一段时间？
steps.explain: since + 时间点（the trip began），表示从那时起一直到现在。

wrong_feedback.A: for 后面跟一段时间（如 for five days）；这里跟的是 the trip began 这个时间点，要用 since。
wrong_feedback.C: during 后面跟一段时间里的时期（如 during the trip），不能跟 began 这样的句子，这里用 since。
wrong_feedback.D: from 只表示起点“从……”，不能把 kept a diary 一直连到现在，这里用 since。

steps.reading: Lin Tao has just come back from Shanghai. He went on a five-day exchange trip there last week. He has kept a diary __1__ the trip began, and he has written about many new things in it. On the first day, his host brother asked him, “Have you __2__ eaten xiaolongbao?” Lin Tao tried some and loved them. He took many photos and bought a small gift for his mum. The school he visited is famous in the city. It __3__ more than a hundred years ago, and many students study there now. “Shanghai is __4__ than I thought,” Lin Tao says. “I have learned a lot on this trip.”

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第2空
steps.scene: 结合短文上下文选词。
steps.stem: On the first day, his host brother asked him, 'Have you ______ eaten xiaolongbao?'
steps.help: 这是在问对方“有没有过这种经历”，想想疑问句里哪个词专门问经历。
steps.explain: Have you ever eaten…? 是问经历的固定问法。

wrong_feedback.B: never 用在肯定句里表示“从没”：I have never eaten…；问句里问经历要用 ever。
wrong_feedback.C: already 多用在肯定句“已经……了”；这里问“吃过吗”，用 ever。
wrong_feedback.D: yet 多放在否定句和疑问句的句尾表示“还（没）”，不放在动词前面；这里问经历用 ever。

steps.reading: Lin Tao has just come back from Shanghai. He went on a five-day exchange trip there last week. He has kept a diary __1__ the trip began, and he has written about many new things in it. On the first day, his host brother asked him, “Have you __2__ eaten xiaolongbao?” Lin Tao tried some and loved them. He took many photos and bought a small gift for his mum. The school he visited is famous in the city. It __3__ more than a hundred years ago, and many students study there now. “Shanghai is __4__ than I thought,” Lin Tao says. “I have learned a lot on this trip.”

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第3空
steps.scene: 结合短文上下文选词。
steps.stem: It ______ more than a hundred years ago, and many students study there now.
steps.help: 先看主语：学校是“建”的发出者，还是“被建”的对象？再看时间：一百多年前。
steps.explain: 学校是被建成的，用被动 was built；一百多年前是过去的时间点，不用完成时。

wrong_feedback.A: built 是主动“建了”，学校自己不能建自己；学校是被建的，要用被动。
wrong_feedback.B: has built 也是主动，而且和 a hundred years ago 这个过去时间点不配。
wrong_feedback.D: builds 是一般现在时，和“一百多年前”这个时间对不上。

steps.reading: Lin Tao has just come back from Shanghai. He went on a five-day exchange trip there last week. He has kept a diary __1__ the trip began, and he has written about many new things in it. On the first day, his host brother asked him, “Have you __2__ eaten xiaolongbao?” Lin Tao tried some and loved them. He took many photos and bought a small gift for his mum. The school he visited is famous in the city. It __3__ more than a hundred years ago, and many students study there now. “Shanghai is __4__ than I thought,” Lin Tao says. “I have learned a lot on this trip.”

steps.title: 挑战 · 完形第4空
steps.scene: 结合短文上下文选词。
steps.stem: 'Shanghai is ______ than I thought,' Lin Tao says.
steps.help: 句子里有 than，先判断这是比较级还是最高级；再想 big 变比较级要不要双写。
steps.explain: 有 than 用比较级；big 双写 g 再加 er：bigger。

wrong_feedback.A: big 是原级，后面有 than，要用比较级。
wrong_feedback.B: biggest 是最高级，要和 the 连用、跟一群比；这里有 than，是两者比较。
wrong_feedback.C: big 是单音节词，比较级直接双写加 er，没有 more big 这种说法。

steps.reading: Lin Tao has just come back from Shanghai. He went on a five-day exchange trip there last week. He has kept a diary __1__ the trip began, and he has written about many new things in it. On the first day, his host brother asked him, “Have you __2__ eaten xiaolongbao?” Lin Tao tried some and loved them. He took many photos and bought a small gift for his mum. The school he visited is famous in the city. It __3__ more than a hundred years ago, and many students study there now. “Shanghai is __4__ than I thought,” Lin Tao says. “I have learned a lot on this trip.”

steps.title: 写一写：信是昨天写的
steps.scene: 广播站收到一封信，你要记录它的来历。
steps.stem: 写出这个句子：这封信是昨天写的。（“写”用 write，要用被动语态）
steps.help: 信自己不会写自己。想一想：谁是动作的承受者？时间又是哪一天？
steps.explain: The letter was written yesterday.（信是被写的，用 was written）

common_errors.say: has written 是“（某人）已经写了”，主语得是写信的人；信是被写的，要用被动：was written。
被动是 be + 过去分词：write 的过去分词是 written，不是过去式 wrote。
信不会自己写，缺了被动的骨架 was；要写 was written。
句子还要写上时间：yesterday 别漏。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 挑战 · 妈妈做过饺子吗
steps.scene: 问妈妈做过饺子吗。
steps.stem: ______ your mum ever cooked dumplings?
steps.help: 先数一数：主语是一个人，还是多个人。
steps.explain: Has your mum ever cooked dumplings?

common_errors.say: 主语 your mum 是一人（第三人称单数），疑问句句首要用 Has，不用 Have。
Is 后面跟不了 cooked 组成完成时；问“做过没有”要用 Has 开头。
Do 后面要跟动词原形 cook，跟不了 cooked；表示经历用 Has。

steps.title: 挑战 · 杰克赢过比赛吗
steps.scene: 问 Jack 赢过比赛吗。
steps.stem: ______ Jack ever won a race?
steps.help: 先看主语是一个还是多个，再看 won 是什么形式。
steps.explain: Has Jack ever won a race?

wrong_feedback.A: Jack 是一人（第三人称单数），完成时疑问句要用 Has 开头，不用 Have。
wrong_feedback.C: Is 后面跟不了 won 组成完成时；问经历要用 Has。
wrong_feedback.D: Did 是过去时的助动词，后面必须跟动词原形 win；won 是过去分词，要配 Has。

steps.title: 写一写：她没见过雪
steps.scene: 同伴来自北方，你想写写她和雪的故事。
steps.stem: 写出这个句子：她从来没见过雪。（“见”用 see，主语用 She）
steps.help: 先想主语是 She，助动词用哪个；再想 see 的过去分词是哪个。
steps.explain: She has never seen snow.（has never + 过去分词 seen）

common_errors.say: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，要用 has：She has never seen…。
saw 是过去式；has 后面要用过去分词 seen。

common_errors.when: 把 never 写在 seen 后面
common_errors.say: never 放在 has 和过去分词中间：has never seen。
“从来没见过”是经历，用现在完成时 has never seen，不用一般现在时。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 挑战 · 老师讲过两次
steps.scene: 班主任已经跟我们讲过两次安全的事。
steps.stem: Our head teacher has ______ to us about safety twice.
steps.help: 先想 speak 的过去分词怎么写，不要拿过去式代替。
steps.explain: Our head teacher has spoken to us about safety twice.

common_errors.say: speak 是不规则动词，过去分词是 spoken，不能加 ed。
spoke 是过去式；has 后面要用过去分词 spoken。
speaking 是现在分词；has 后面用过去分词 spoken。

steps.title: 挑战 · 去年建成的大桥
steps.scene: 这座新桥是去年建成的。
steps.stem: The new bridge ______ last year.
steps.task: 写出空里的两个词（be 动词 + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先看时间是去年还是现在，再想桥是自己建的还是被建的。
steps.explain: The new bridge was built last year.

common_errors.say: is built 是现在的被动；题目说的是去年，要用过去的 was built。
built 是主动语态的过去式；桥是被建成的，被动语态不能少了 was：was built。
be 动词后面要用过去分词：build 的过去分词是 built，写 was built。

steps.title: 写一写：最美味的一餐
steps.scene: 日记里夸一夸交流时吃到的最好吃的一餐。
steps.stem: 写出这个句子：这是我吃过的最美味的一餐。
steps.task: 写出完整的英文句子（最高级 + 现在完成时）。
steps.answer_text: This is the most delicious meal I have ever eaten.
steps.help: “最美味”用最高级，别忘了 the；“吃过的”要用完成时，eat 的过去分词是哪个？
steps.explain: This is the most delicious meal I have ever eaten.

common_errors.say: “最美味”是最高级：the most delicious；more 是比较级，跟别人比的时候才用。
ate 是过去式；have 后面要用过去分词 eaten：have ever eaten。
最高级前面要加 the：the most delicious meal。

common_errors.when: 写了 has ever eaten（主语是 I）
common_errors.say: 句子里“我”是 I，用 have：I have ever eaten。

steps.reading: Model diary: I have met two friends. I have already visited the park. I have never eaten hotpot, but I want to try it because it smells nice.

steps.title: 挑战 · 学校里用电脑
steps.scene: 我们学校每天都用电脑上课。
steps.stem: Computers ______ in our school every day.
steps.task: 写出空里的两个词（be 动词 + 过去分词）。
steps.help: 先数主语是一个还是多个，再想电脑是自己用自己还是被人用的。
steps.explain: Computers are used in our school every day.

common_errors.say: 主语 Computers 是多个，be 动词要用 are，不能用 is：are used。
used 单独放是主动的过去式；电脑是被人用的，被动语态要带 be 动词：are used。
be 动词后面要用过去分词：use 的过去分词是 used，写 are used。

steps.title: 挑战 · 三个人谁更高
steps.scene: 汤姆比蒂姆高，但吉姆是三个人里最高的。
steps.stem: Tom is ______ than Tim, but Jim is ______ of the three.
steps.task: 写出两个空里的词（第一个空一个词，第二个空两个词）。
steps.answer_text: Tom is taller than Tim, but Jim is the tallest of the three.
steps.help: 先分清两个空：第一个是两个人比，第二个是三个人里最……。
steps.explain: Tom is taller than Tim, but Jim is the tallest of the three.

common_errors.say: 第一个空后面有 than，是两个人比高低，用比较级 taller；最高级留给第二个空。
第二个空是三个人里最高的，要用最高级 the tallest，不能用比较级。

common_errors.when: 写了 more taller 或 more tallest
common_errors.say: tall 是单音节词，直接加 er/est：taller、tallest，前面不能再加 more。

common_errors.when: 两个空都写了 the tallest
common_errors.say: 只有第二个空是“最”；第一个空有 than，用比较级 taller 就行，不要带 the。

steps.title: 写一段：我的交流日记
steps.scene: 交流墙要选日记贴出来。轮到你写一段交流日记（4–5 句），交给站长。
steps.stem: 写一段日记，必须写到这三件事：① 一个你去过的地方（have been to / have visited）；② 一件你还没做过的事（have never …）；③ 你在那里待了多久，或者从什么时候起（for … / since …）。
steps.task: 写 4–5 句英文，三件事一件都不能少。
steps.answer_text: I have been to Beijing with my family. I have visited the Great Wall there. I have never tried skiing. I have lived in Guangzhou for twelve years.

cn: 待了多久 / 从何时起

steps.help: 一句一句来：先写去过哪里，再写没做过什么，最后一句写待了多久或者从何时起。
steps.explain: 范文：I have been to Beijing with my family. I have visited the Great Wall there. I have never tried skiing. I have lived in Guangzhou for twelve years.

common_errors.say: 三件事少了一件：还没做过的事。用 I have never … 补一句，如 I have never tried skiing。
第一件事还没写：去过的地方要用 have been to 或 have visited 开头写一句。
最后一件事还没写：补上待了多久，for 后面跟一段时间（for two years），或者 since 后面跟起点（since 2023）。
写经历要用现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词（如 have visited），不要只写 visited、went 这样的过去式。

common_errors.when: 写了 has been to（主语是 I）
common_errors.say: 主语是 I 的时候用 have，不是 has：I have been to …。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
日记都写好了。站长说：交流墙贴满了，节目里要读几篇。

下一期是交流大直播——quiz 问答，把这单元全复习一遍。
